name: linalg_solve_ex
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::linalg_solve_ex(Tensor A, Tensor B, *, bool left=True, bool check_errors=False) -> (Tensor result, Tensor info). Solves AX=B and returns the differentiable solution plus an int32 status tensor without mutating or aliasing A or B. Coverage includes unbatched and batched systems, broadcast batches, empty batches, singular error checking, output metadata, explicit storage non-aliasing, gradients for both A and B, invalid shapes and dtypes, and the current kernel's explicit left=False rejection contract.
